text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hirschsprung's Disease. The combination of bilious vomiting, failure to pass meconium, and an abdominal X-ray showing dilated bowel loops with no distal gas confirms a distal intestinal obstruction, most consistent with congenital aganglionosis.
